title: 機翼翼型與升阻分析
summary: 以原創翼型模型逐步連接動壓、表面壓力、升阻係數、相似性及測量不確定度；不把二維翼型曲線直接當全機性能。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Connect dynamic pressure, surface pressure, lift/drag coefficients, similarity and uncertainty using original airfoil models, without treating two-dimensional section curves as whole-aircraft performance. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 風洞參考動壓：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Tunnel reference dynamic pressure: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 風洞參考動壓 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Tunnel reference dynamic pressure and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 動壓是單位體積動能，速度平方使高速下的小速度誤差放大；靜壓與總壓不能互換。
steps.instructionEn: Dynamic pressure is kinetic energy per volume; its square-speed dependence amplifies speed errors, and static and total pressure are not interchangeable.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非機翼翼型與升阻分析實際性能或製程：密度ρ=1.20 kg/m³，模型速度V=30 m/s。式 q=ρV²/2，基準結果 540 Pa。適用條件：低馬赫、定密度教學流；可壓縮流需修正。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Wing airfoil and lift-drag analysis: Density rho=1.20 kg/m³ and model speed V=30 m/s. Formula q=ρV²/2 gives 540 Pa. Conditions: Low-Mach constant-density teaching flow; compressible flow needs correction.
steps.failure: 壓管漏氣或把靜壓當動壓會造成速度偏差，先查管路再改模型係數。
steps.failureEn: Leaking pressure lines or treating static pressure as dynamic pressure biases speed; check plumbing before changing model coefficients.
steps.check: 比較差壓計零點、總壓孔與靜壓孔位置，再將每秒資料配對取樣。
steps.checkEn: Compare transducer zero and total/static port positions, then pair time-stamped samples.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再僅把V改成36 m/s；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 540 改為 777.6 Pa。在算式區重算並記下對「風洞參考動壓」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only V to 36 m/s, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 540 to 777.6 Pa. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Tunnel reference dynamic pressure, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 動壓是單位體積動能，速度平方使高速下的小速度誤差放大；靜壓與總壓不能互換。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
速度加倍只會使動壓加倍。
optionsEn: Dynamic pressure is kinetic energy per volume; its square-speed dependence amplifies speed errors, and static and total pressure are not interchangeable.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Doubling speed only doubles dynamic pressure.
quiz.explanation: 動壓是單位體積動能，速度平方使高速下的小速度誤差放大；靜壓與總壓不能互換。 比較差壓計零點、總壓孔與靜壓孔位置，再將每秒資料配對取樣。
quiz.explanationEn: Dynamic pressure is kinetic energy per volume; its square-speed dependence amplifies speed errors, and static and total pressure are not interchangeable. Compare transducer zero and total/static port positions, then pair time-stamped samples.

steps.title: 翼型尺度與雷諾數：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Airfoil scale and Reynolds number: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 翼型尺度與雷諾數 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Airfoil scale and Reynolds number and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 雷諾數比較慣性與黏滯作用，決定邊界層及轉捩條件；小模型與原型的速度相同不代表流場相似。
steps.instructionEn: Reynolds number compares inertia and viscosity and affects boundary layers and transition; equal model and full-scale speed does not imply similar flow.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非機翼翼型與升阻分析實際性能或製程：ρ=1.2 kg/m³，V=30 m/s，弦長c=0.5 m，μ=1.8×10⁻⁵ Pa·s。式 Re=ρVc/μ，基準結果 1000000 dimensionless。適用條件：單一參考長度與定物性，尚須同時檢查馬赫數與粗糙度。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Wing airfoil and lift-drag analysis: rho=1.2 kg/m³, V=30 m/s, chord c=0.5 m and mu=1.8e-5 Pa·s. Formula Re=ρVc/μ gives 1000000 dimensionless. Conditions: One reference length and constant properties; Mach number and roughness also require checks.
steps.failure: 把公分當公尺會造成100倍誤差；只靠Re相同也不能消除風洞壁效應。
steps.failureEn: Treating centimetres as metres creates a factor-of-100 error; matching Re does not remove tunnel-wall effects.
steps.check: 保留風洞溫度、密度、黏度計算與弦長，對照轉捩位置或邊界層資料。
steps.checkEn: Retain tunnel temperature, density, viscosity calculation and chord, and compare transition or boundary-layer evidence.

knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only c to 0.25 m, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 1000000 to 500000 dimensionless. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Airfoil scale and Reynolds number, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?

optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Keeping speed fixed preserves Reynolds number after scaling down.
Reynolds number compares inertia and viscosity and affects boundary layers and transition; equal model and full-scale speed does not imply similar flow.
